notes: Prose is generic-asset on the daily timeframe, matching the AAPL 1d binding (1507 rows, 2020-2025); all levels are percentages so no orphaned-price risk. Entry is unpinned because the trend filter is optional ('an additional condition can be added... determined by EMA(50). For example...') so faithful implementations fork on including it, and the 0.5% threshold's base (Close vs EMA_forecast) is unstated. Exit is unpinned: the crossover exit ('crosses the forecast EMA... from above to below') vs level test, plus 2% stop-loss / 3% take-profit whose intrabar-stop-order vs close-check mechanics and same-bar priority are unspecified and outside D4a defaults. Sizing is hedged ('Fixed, for example, 100% of available capital'), and literal 100%-of-cash orders under commission 0.001 force divergent margin-rejection workarounds that can remove fills from the tape.
